prompts.textures: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production pixel-art texture atlas for a Three.js HD-2D game, square image exactly 1024x1024. Four equal seamless material tiles in a 2 by 2 grid, no padding, no border, each tile exactly 512x512. Top left: weathered charcoal blue-grey cobblestone paving, small irregular rectangular stones, rain-dark crevices, subtle aged grime. Top right: old dark blue-grey brick wall, horizontal mortar, worn corners. Bottom left: scratched tarnished dark bronze industrial metal panel. Bottom right: stained desaturated warm-grey plaster wall. Consistent handcrafted pixel-art low-resolution look, visible crisp square pixel clusters, restrained 16-color palette, no smooth digital painting, no diagonal perspective. Flat orthographic material swatches with gentle upper-left highlights, suitable to wrap actual 3D geometry. A late-night exhausted stock exchange alley, melancholic black comedy, no neon colors, no grass, no bright toy colors. No letters, labels, numbers, UI, objects, characters, shadows or watermark.
prompts.sprites: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production game sprite atlas, transparent background with alpha. Exactly 4 columns and 5 rows, 20 equal cells, entire square canvas 1024 by 1024, no grid lines, no text. Each character centered in its cell, feet at same baseline within each row, consistent scale, generous transparent spacing to avoid touching. Original anthropomorphic brown worker ANT with antennae, large heavy eyelids, 3 segmented body, narrow legs, worn blue-grey work jacket, sober melancholic black comedy; not cute toy, not recognizable existing game character. Crisp pixel art about 48 by 56 source pixels per character, enlarged nearest neighbor, consistent charcoal/dusty bronze/desaturated teal/warm yellow palette, light upper left. Columns always: front three-quarter facing viewer; facing left; facing right; back view. Row 1 neutral ant idle, hands lowered. Row 2 same ant walking pose left foot forward. Row 3 same ant walking pose right foot forward. Row 4 fearful exhausted ant hunched, drooping antennae, carrying small battered suitcase. Row 5 hopeful same ant tiny raised fist and small amber scarf, restrained cheer. No background, no floors, no shadows, no UI, no typography, no extra props outside cells. Accurate aligned atlas, same anatomy and apparent height throughout.
